products.name: Google Drive & Shared Drives Architecture, Permissions & Governance — Commercial
products.short_description: Design the Google Drive & Shared Drives architecture — taxonomy, membership/role model, external/link-sharing policy, target audiences, DLP-aligned controls, and ownership/lifecycle governance — so collaboration is easy and data stays controlled. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Design Drive and Shared Drives so sharing stays under control

Left ungoverned, Google Drive becomes a sprawl of over-shared files and orphaned ownership. This solution designs the Drive & Shared Drives architecture: a Shared Drives taxonomy and naming model, membership/role design, external-sharing and link-sharing policy, target-audience and trust rules, DLP-aligned sharing controls, and ownership/lifecycle governance — so collaboration is easy but data stays where it belongs.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (Admin SDK / APIs).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Drive model: My Drive vs Shared Drives, taxonomy, roles/membership, external + link-sharing policy, target audiences, and governance/lifecycle.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace tenant + super-admin, groups source of truth, data-classification/DLP policy, stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — define the Shared Drives taxonomy + naming, set membership/role model, configure external/link-sharing + target audiences, align DLP sharing controls, and stand up ownership/lifecycle governance — pilot-first, each drive/policy named.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (sharing scoped to policy, no orphaned ownership, governance reporting) plus Best Practices for keeping Drive governed as it grows.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Drive collaboration that stays under control — a clear Shared Drives taxonomy, scoped sharing, DLP-aligned controls, and governed ownership — easy to use, safe by design.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • drive_governance_config_helper.py — build/validate the Shared Drives governance catalog (local only)
    • drive_governance_report.py — Shared Drive governance & lifecycle report (HTML/JSON)
    • drive_sharing_exposure_assessment.py — read-only Drive sharing-exposure baseline (Stage 0)
    • external_sharing_policy_validator.py — go/no-go gate: does live sharing match the designed policy?
    • shared_drive_provisioner.py — provision Shared Drives + group membership to the naming/role model

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
